title: Paystride Fees Due on a Reversed Claim, Paystride Visa Payroll Card Premier and Elite
content:
On the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Premier and Elite plans, the Paystride fees a reversed lost or stolen card claim is due follow the claimed transaction.

| Claimed transaction | Fees the claim is due |
|---|---|
| Paystride fees were charged on it (an out-of-network ATM fee, an international ATM fee or a foreign transaction fee) | those fees less any part of them already returned by refund or correction |
| a withdrawal at a domestic out-of-network ATM that carried no out-of-network ATM fee because it was one of its pay period's free withdrawals | the plan's out-of-network ATM withdrawal fee, for the free withdrawal it used: 1.75 on Premier, 1.50 on Elite |
| anything else | nothing |

For a claim whose reversal the claim reversal schedule for the Premier and Elite plans prices, and only for such a claim, the fees counted in what the claim is due are settled by that reversal and not corrected again. A fee counted in what a claim is due under the claim reversal schedule for the Premier and Elite plans, and only such a fee, is not corrected again. The other lost or stolen card claim schedules of the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Account state their own.

*Hypothetical cases:*
- A Premier claim on an out-of-network withdrawal beyond the free allowance, whose 1.75 fee was not returned, is due 1.75.
- The same claim after that fee was refunded is due 0.00 in fees.
- An Elite claim on a foreign-currency purchase carrying a foreign transaction fee of 0.96 is due 0.96.
